{{Top|leg}}
'''Tellak Skrep''' was a genius biochemist by the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]. He manufactured a self-replenishing [[Stimulant/Legends|stim]] known as [[The Buzz]]. This stim eventually fell into the hands of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] soldier [[Orm Kreg]], who was killed by a [[Tineback]] known as [[The Scrabbler]], who also ate the sample. The sample was recovered by the [[Alliance Commander]], who went on to manufacture more of it.<ref name="RelicHunt">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Relic Hunt: Self-Replenishing Stim|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>
